_comment: Cross-implementation vectors for the §10.4 evidence encodings of the E2E protocol spec,
plus end-to-end bundle-verification cases. GENERATED BY A THIRD IMPLEMENTATION (stdlib
Python; scripts/gen_e2e_certificate_fixture.py), whose signature arithmetic is itself
pinned to the published RFC 8032 §7.1 and RFC 6979 A.2.5 answers before it emits a byte.
certificate = LP(grant) || LP(evidence)      evidence = assertion | raw Ed25519 signature
EVERY NEGATIVE CASE MUTATES ONE THING AND IS RE-SIGNED, so it fails for exactly one reason
and names it in `expect`. A verifier that rejects everything passes none of them.
Regenerate with scripts/gen_e2e_certificate_fixture.py; never edit a value by hand.

cases.name: evidence/crafted-64-bytes-parse-as-assertion
cases.note: issuer_kind decides the evidence form; never probe. real_signature does NOT parse.

verify.name: self-signed-root-grant
verify.note: a probing verifier accepts this with capabilities 7; issuer_kind is what refuses it

verify.name: device-root-mismatch
verify.note: only the device descriptor names another root; the grant's own fields are correct

verify.name: grant-v1-label-refused
verify.note: a bundle minted before the commitment change; the v1 label is no longer a grant

verify.name: chain-first-not-root-issued
verify.note: B's device-issued grant presented alone, with its genuine signature

verify.name: noise-static-mismatch
verify.note: A's DH key, presented for B's chain — the certified leaf must be the Noise peer
